summary: Aegon Ltd filed a 6-K announcing repurchase of all outstanding Common Shares B from its largest shareholder, Vereniging Aegon Americas, in exchange for common shares with equal voting rights on a 40-to-1 basis; the interim bye-laws approved at the October 8, 2026 EGM became effective October 15, 2026. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Mechanics replace a distinct B-share class with common shares, eliminating the dual-class voting overhang. Watch post-exchange ownership concentration, Vereniging Aegon's resulting stake, and any subsequent sell-down or liquidity impact.
